name: Infrastructure Deploy
description: Validate, plan, and apply infrastructure changes using Terraform, scoped to a specific environment.

config_path.description: Path to the Terraform configuration directory

steps.description: Validate the Terraform configuration for syntax and internal consistency
Generate an execution plan showing what changes will be applied
Apply the planned infrastructure changes to the target environment

constraints: All changes are scoped to the declared environment only
Production deploys require explicit human approval at the apply step
Plan output must be reviewed before apply executes
invariants: No cross-environment resource modification is possible
The apply step only executes the exact plan generated in the plan step
Terraform state is never manually edited or bypassed
